newsitem.title: UK: Commonwealth sets October for 1997 summit.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth sets October for 1997 summit.

text.p: The Commonwealth, the grouping of former British colonies and dependencies, will hold a heads of government summit meeting in Edinburgh from October 24 to 27 next year, the bloc's secretariat announced on Wednesday.
It will be the first meeting of Commonwealth leaders since last year's in Auckland, New Zealand, and the first in Britain for 20 years.

"I am confident that the 1997 Edinburgh CHOGM (Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting) will mark another historic milestone in the evolution of the modern Commonwealth," said the bloc's Secretary-General Chief Emeka Anyaoku.
The Commonwealth, whose head is Britain's Queen Elizabeth, links 53 developed and developing countries.
